Do I need building approval for a retaining wall in Canberra? It depends on wall height, location and design. ACT Planning publishes BA exemption conditions under Schedule 1; check the actual proposal before work starts. Do I need development approval for a retaining wall in the ACT? Possibly. Fill, cut-in and combination walls have different DA exemption thresholds, including boundary-related limits. How is retaining wall height measured in Canberra? The BA guidance measures from the top of the wall to the lowest adjacent ground level; DA guidance also uses datum ground level for some tests. Does a 1.2 metre retaining wall need approval in Canberra? Height alone is not enough. Location, exemption conditions, easements and other structures can change the answer. Can a retaining wall be built near a stormwater easement? It may require a site plan and special engineering so footings clear and do not load the stormwater asset.
